scope: All 63 remaining whole-token forms ending in noncanonical -nih across 19 adjective/passive-participle types: 62 base-paper sites and one paper-45 site.
choice: Replace the hard n-stem genitive/locative plural ending -nih with canonical -nyh at every audited site.
motivation: Every site is genitive or locative plural agreement for a hard n-final adjective or passive participle; the official regular paradigm requires -nyh/-enyh/-jenyh.
alternatives_rejected: Retaining -nih preserves a mixed national declension layer.
Blind substring replacement was rejected; only 19 exact whole-token types and their complete corpus counts were admitted.

evidence.official_adjective_grammar: adjectives.md SHA-256 184348005ACB532868DAEB35DBFB7A8E05A493D550B4D6FA2E1A3BCFC906D84F, lines 14, 16 and 18: regular agreement; only š/ž/č/j stems are soft; these n-stems are hard.
evidence.official_verb_grammar: verbs.md SHA-256 3684BE0634F0163DDD4BEC09719280C3C0E1E2367009AA3DAE584C50DD6249AD, lines 180 and 182: passive participles in -ny/-eny/-jeny, then regular adjective declension.
evidence.official_dictionary: isv_words_list.csv SHA-256 072DE8E512EB386780D199FBD6F0ACF2639D3096EA920F1AF2D0AFCC5535E842 directly attests danyh and oddělnyh.
evidence.semantic_review: All 63 sentences were inspected; comments, foreign arguments, control names, internal substrings, other cases/numbers and pre-existing canonical forms are excluded.

validation.coverage: Exact 19-type source histogram totaling 63 whole-token sites.
validation.postcondition: All 19 source types and generic whole-token *nih residue are zero; exact target histogram totals 177.
validation.structure: Byte counts, ordered TeX controls, braces, math delimiters and line counts invariant; unchanged components byte-identical.
validation.reproducibility: Frozen successor hashes reproduced before atomic apply.
